name: provisioning
description: The hardest suite: realistic provisioning that strings several verified steps together — directory layouts, multi-key env files, executable scripts with specific modes, recorded host facts, and a full mini-service capstone. Each task needs genuine decomposition and proves the result through multiple independent filesystem checks at once.

tasks.name: app-layout
tasks.objective: create an application layout under /tmp/ada-bench-prov/app with the subdirectories bin, etc, and var, and prove that all three subdirectories exist

tasks.name: env-file-three-keys
tasks.objective: write /tmp/ada-bench-prov/app/etc/app.env containing the three lines 'ENV=prod', 'PORT=8090', and 'NAME=ada', and prove the file contains all three lines

tasks.name: executable-healthcheck
tasks.objective: create an executable health-check script /tmp/ada-bench-prov/app/bin/health.sh whose first line is the shebang '#!/bin/sh' and which contains the line 'echo ok', set its mode to 0755, and prove the file exists with mode 0755 and contains a line matching '^echo ok$'

tasks.name: owner-and-config
tasks.objective: record the current user into /tmp/ada-bench-prov/app/var/owner.txt and create /tmp/ada-bench-prov/app/etc/config.yaml containing the line 'mode: prod', and prove the owner file is non-empty and the config contains a line matching '^mode: prod$'

tasks.name: mini-service-capstone
tasks.objective: provision a complete mini-service at /tmp/ada-bench-prov/srv: create the directories conf and logs, write conf/service.yaml containing the lines 'name: ada' and 'mode: prod', create an executable conf/start.sh (mode 0755) containing the line 'echo starting', and prove that both directories exist, the yaml contains both lines, and start.sh exists with mode 0755
